notes: τὸ καθ᾽ ἡμέραν → 'daily': the article contributes no part of the fused word and stays unrepresented (rule 93), while κατά and ἡμέραν are one aligned unit under rule 39's test.
οἱ πρῶτοι → 'the principal men' gives the determiner and the supplied nominal to the article, headed on 'men' (rule 102).
